summary: Iteration 7 - Frontend-only verification of (a) new red QR-invalid full-screen UI, (b) admin panel action buttons (delete merchant, edit-discount modal, force-edit/lucchetto, inline approve/reject), (c) discount detail image fallback. All key flows PASS. Minor fix applied: added z-[100] to QRVerify fullscreen containers because navbar (z-40 sticky) was visually on top of the red screen. All 9 required Italian strings present, Ban icon inside white circle rendered, screenshots confirm full-screen coverage over navbar after fix. Admin panel: throwaway merchant registered via /auth/register, admin logged in, master password (ValeRoma2026) verified via UI, Merchants tab shows 14 rows with 9 discounts. All action buttons present in expected counts (force-edit=9, edit-disc=9, admin-delete-discount=9, admin-merchant-edit=14, admin-merchant-delete=14). Throwaway merchant deleted via admin-merchant-delete-{id} → row gone + verified absent in /api/admin/merchants (no 404/500). Force-edit on trattoria discount → success toast 'Sblocco riuscito'. Edit-discount modal opens with admin-disc-title/original/discounted fields; title change saved via PUT /admin/discounts/{id} and reflected in the row (then restored). Inline approve/reject buttons: 0 present because there are no pending discounts in the current DB - not a bug, just no data to exercise. DiscountDetail: 7 approved discounts checked - all show images with valid src (Unsplash fallback URLs) and naturalWidth=800, zero broken.
action_items: Consider seeding a pending discount in dev DB so inline-approve/inline-reject buttons can be exercised end-to-end by future automated tests (currently 0 pending → 0 inline buttons).
critical_code_review_comments: QRVerify.jsx originally used `fixed inset-0` with no z-index; Navbar is `sticky top-0 z-40` so it stayed on top of the invalid/valid overlay. Fixed by adding z-[100] to both qr-invalid and qr-valid containers (matches requirement 'covering navbar (z-100)').
GET /api/discounts and /api/admin/merchants return wrapped objects ({discounts:[...]} / {merchants:[...]}). Consumers must unwrap - fine, but worth documenting.

GET /api/discounts/{id} does not expose approval_status / force_editable fields on the public payload, so external test harnesses cannot verify force-edit flag flip from the public endpoint (verified indirectly via UI toast 'Sblocco riuscito').

seed_data_creation: Registered and then deleted throwaway merchant DelShop <suffix> for delete flow verification. Left one pre-existing extra merchant (DelShop 26668, DelTest Shop 26606) from previous iterations still in DB - harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: QR red screen fully working (with the z-[100] fix applied by testing agent). Admin panel action buttons all functional. No pending discounts to test inline-approve/inline-reject in the current DB - if E1 wants to test those, either seed a pending discount (approval_status='pending') or use a fresh merchant that submits a discount via merchant portal.
rca of the issue: The 'red screen should cover navbar' requirement was partially broken: QRVerify's outer div had `fixed inset-0` (position:fixed, top/right/bottom/left:0) but no z-index, so it stacked at z-auto (0). The site Navbar uses `sticky top-0 z-40`. A z-40 element paints above a z-auto sibling, hence the navbar remained visible on top of the red overlay. Reproduction: navigate to /qr/BOGUS.123.abc → red screen visible but navbar bar (Sconti Roma / Accedi / Iscriviti) still overlays the top. Mitigation applied: added `z-[100]` to both `qr-invalid` and `qr-valid` container divs in /app/frontend/src/pages/QRVerify.jsx. Verified visually via screenshot after fix - navbar no longer visible on top of the red screen.
